name: Satoh & Co., Ltd.
summary: Satoh & Co., Ltd. sells commercial food products in Japan. Its wholesale division sells and delivers confectionery bread and school lunch materials, restaurants, and other food dishes for retail stores. The retail division sells various commercial foods primarily cooked cold foods to individual business operators and general consumers at the commercial food direct sales center. It also processes and sells meat; conducts inspections of food, water quality, etc.; plans, develops, and sells menu databases and information systems; and provides logistics consignment services for commercial food. Satoh & Co., Ltd. was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Sendai, Japan.
